findings.tree: zelkova a, zelkova d, broadleaf grove
findings.issue: AFTER grain is finer and more evenly distributed than BEFORE; fewer large dark interior pockets, so big crowns read slightly flatter and busier (less clump-on-clump depth). Per-clump lighting still carries the volume, and it reads as foliage at 1x.
Tiled preview shows a mild consistent diagonal (lower-left to upper-right) stroke bias. No seams and no obvious 32px grid at 3x3 tiling, but the directional bias is visible at 8x in large flat areas.
Slightly more isolated single-pixel light tones on crown interiors than BEFORE; not salt-and-pepper at 1x, and persimmon fruit stays legible.
Pine pads take the same broadleaf-style grain as before; no regression, but no needle character either (unchanged behaviour).

checks.reads_as_clumps_1x: yes; no checkerboard, stripes, seams or visible 32px repetition
checks.pixel_noise_vs_before: comparable, marginally busier, not worse in a blocking way
checks.joseon_fit_same_family: yes; silhouettes, ramp, lighting and trunks identical, same tree family

summary: New hand-drawn leaf texture tiles cleanly (no seams/grid/checkerboard) and the AFTER trees remain the same Joseon/Baram family. Only minor issues: finer, slightly flatter and busier grain on the large crowns and a mild diagonal stroke bias in the texture. No blocker or major findings.
